Ingredients:

1 kilogram potatoes, peeled

1/2 cup fresh mint (loose), chopped

1/2 teaspoon ground cumin (jeera)

1 green bell pepper, finely chopped

3-4 cloves of garlic, finely chopped

1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger

2 tablespoons all-purpose flour (pagri)

2-3 tablespoons vegetable oil

1/2 cup all-purpose flour (pagri)

Salt to taste

1/2 cup crumbled bacon (saunf)

Method:

1. First make the chips by mixing the flour, bread crumbs and cumin, turmeric and salt together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

3. Drain the potatoes and keep aside.
